title: --remove --dry-run prints the removal diff and leaves the file as it is
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup instructions, defect N-18): a delimited, reversible JITSO block in the instruction files agents read
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-18, setup instructions). After the block is written, `--remove --dry-run` previews the lines that would go (`-<!-- BEGIN JITSO ...`), ends with the dry-run line and exit 0, and the file keeps its bytes. The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout: jitso setup instructions: dry run, nothing written
